findings.evidence: release_policy.py:14 compares the digest strings with !=.
findings.summary: Digest equality uses != instead of hmac.compare_digest.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:16-18 uses roots and change["path"] without validation. A missing path raises KeyError, and an empty root matches every path.
findings.summary: Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths; malformed values can also raise instead of failing closed.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:18 allows path "release-extra/file" under root "release" because startswith returns true.
findings.summary: Scope matching uses a raw string prefix, so a sibling path can pass.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:17-19 reads only change["path"]; a record with path "release/file", an out-of-scope rename source, or an unknown action can return true.
findings.summary: Rename sources and actions are ignored, allowing an out-of-scope source or unknown action to pass.
Production dispatch functions still call legacy_route instead of route_request directly.

findings.evidence: routing.py:13-19 defines its own routes dictionary and lookup.
findings.summary: legacy_route duplicates the routing implementation instead of directly delegating to route_request.
